title: Mashawana mountain, Thohoyandou police area (approx.): two unidentified men found dead; cause unknown, police investigating, 4 Oct
summary: Cause of death unknown. Police are investigating; the report does not say whether an inquest or a murder case was opened. A cattle herder found the bodies of two unidentified men lying next to each other in a remote part...
story: Cause of death unknown. Police are investigating; the report does not say whether an inquest or a murder case was opened. A cattle herder found the bodies of two unidentified men lying next to each other in a remote part of Mashawana mountain at about 13:30 on Sunday 4 October, with pots, cups, bedding and other utensils nearby (Limpopo Mirror, 8 October). A resident said the bodies were badly decomposed and showed no injuries; that is a resident's account, not a post-mortem finding. Vhembe police spokesperson Captain Vuledzani Dathi confirmed that Thohoyandou police are investigating. The men have not been identified, and residents' guesses about who they were are not repeated here. One report. The pin is approximate: the mountain is not on the map, so the pin is the Dzwerani village point, one of the two communities the report names. This pin is checked in every three-day collection run and will be updated if police confirm a cause of death, identify the men or open a case.
incident: Found at about 13:30 on Sun 4 Oct 2026 by a cattle herder; when the men died is not known (Limpopo Mirror). Cause of death unknown; Thohoyandou police are investigating (police, via Limpopo Mirror).
location_note: A remote mountainous part of Mashawana mountain; the report names the communities of Mashawana and Dzwerani, Thulamela municipality, and Thohoyandou police are investigating. The mountain is not in the gazetteer or OpenStreetMap, so the pin is the Dzwerani village point from GeoNames. That point falls just inside the Vuwani precinct outline, about 3.3 km from the Thohoyandou precinct edge, so the scene is probably a few kilometres from the pin. Approximate, village level (about 6 km).
